Against ...h6, h4 first, then g5; against ...Bb4, Bd3; against ...Be7 or ...Nbd7, g5 at once.
(5... h6 6. h4 Bd6 7. Qf3) (5... Bb4 6. Bd3) (5... Be7 6. g5 Nfd7 7. h4) (5... Nbd7 6. g5)
